shots.focal_element: Large serif headline 'Focus on your customers' in the lower-left orange panel, with a pill of five customer avatar portraits above and a cut-out photo of a smiling woman at right
shots.typography: Large high-contrast serif display face, bold weight, sentence case, tight tracking, two lines left-aligned in reversed-out light text on a solid panel; font name unknown (low-confidence guess: a Lexend/Queens-style editorial serif).
shots.what_happens: Flat colour-block panels slide into a four-quadrant grid: a dark top-left panel holding a rounded pill of five circular customer portraits with a people-icon badge, an orange headline panel rising beneath it, a striped orange block top-right and a cut-out portrait with sparkle glyphs bottom-right; the headline lands on the VO 'focus on what matters most, your customers' (w113-w119) and then holds.
shots.build_rebuild: Build a 2x2 CSS grid of solid colour panels that slide in from below with an ease-out stagger (~150 ms), place a rounded pill containing five overlapping circular avatar images plus a circular icon badge in the top-left cell, a two-line serif headline in the bottom-left cell, and a transparent-background portrait with two small sparkle SVGs in the bottom-right cell.

shots.focal_element: Cut-out photo of a support agent wearing a headset, typing on a laptop, set against a large orange half-circle
shots.what_happens: The previous grid slides away to a cream canvas with an orange strip on the left and a small orange dot; the dot grows into a large orange half-circle behind a cut-out of a headset-wearing support agent at a desk with laptop, plant and books, while three sparkle glyphs pop in one by one beside her raised hand, illustrating 'world-class customer support' (w120-w126).
shots.build_rebuild: On a cream background with a thin orange header strip, scale a single orange circle from a 0.05 dot to a large radius anchored at right of centre, fade/slide a transparent-PNG person-at-desk cut-out in front of it, then pop three four-point star SVGs in with a staggered scale-up overshoot.

shots.focal_element: 'HubSpot Academy' logo displayed on the screen of a desktop monitor in a styled desk scene
shots.typography: Brand wordmark: geometric sans, bold 'HubSpot' with the sprocket logo replacing the 'o', regular-weight 'Academy' below, title case, normal tracking.
shots.what_happens: The support-agent scene is pushed off to the right as the frame moves onto a new cream desk scene: a desktop monitor showing the HubSpot Academy logo, flanked by a snake plant, headphones on books, a lamp and pencil cup, with small orange dot and star accents; it pulls back slightly to reveal the full desk on 'free educational resources' (w127-w129).
shots.build_rebuild: Horizontally translate the previous scene out while the new scene (a monitor mock-up PNG with an HTML logo lockup on its screen and prop cut-outs around it) translates in from the left, then animate a slight scale-down from ~1.15 to 1.0 with ease-out to reveal the whole desk.

A lesson-overview body paragraph and per-section meta lines (e.g. video counts and durations) are too small to quote reliably and are omitted.
shots.what_happens: The Academy logo on the monitor crossfades into a real Academy course screen (top nav, 'Inbound Marketing' course outline sidebar, instructor video player, lesson overview) while the camera pushes in on the monitor so the UI fills most of the frame; an orange sprocket badge peeks in at the left edge near the end, covering 'and integrations' (w130-w131).
shots.build_rebuild: Inside the monitor mock-up, crossfade the logo layer to a full-page product screenshot over ~300 ms while scaling the whole desk group from 1.0 to ~1.6 around the screen centre with an ease-in-out push-in.

shots.focal_element: Counter '1,500 +' beside a central HubSpot sprocket node and the label 'app integrations', surrounded by a network of circular partner-app logo nodes
shots.typography: Counter and label in the same high-contrast serif display face as the earlier headlines, bold, lower case for 'app integrations', large numerals with tight tracking; 'plum' and 'SMSit!' are third-party logo wordmarks inside nodes.
shots.what_happens: An orange chevron-shaped wipe sweeps across the desk scene to an orange field with a thin-line network of cream circular nodes holding app logos (Google Ads, Gmail, Facebook, WordPress, Zoom, Outlook, Office, Mailchimp, Zapier, Google Calendar, etc.) linked to a central HubSpot sprocket; a number counts up (915, 1,439) to '1,500 +' synced to 'more than 1,500 apps' (w133-w137), the label appears and the network drifts slowly.
shots.build_rebuild: Reveal an orange layer through an arrow-shaped clip-path wipe, lay out ~20 circular logo nodes joined by 1px low-opacity lines to a central sprocket node, count a serif number from 0 to 1,500 over ~1 s with ease-out and append '+', fade in 'app integrations', and drift the node group a few pixels for ambient motion.
